Messages.Author: Ira
Messages.Body:
Hey LSJ,

How does Resilient Mind interact with Lunatic Eruption? Does the
card still go in play? Is blood only burned once for the whole time
the card remains in play?

How does Resilient Mind vs. Vitae Block - does Vitae Block still go
in play?

How does Resilient Mind interact with Anesthetic Touch?

Thanks!

Ira

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"Ira" <ira...@yahoo.com> a écrit dans le message de
news:500e74e.04072...@posting.google.com...

Resilient Mind [BH:R]
Cardtype: Action

Discipline: Fortitude

+1 stealth action.
[for] Put this card on the acting vampire. When another minion plays an
action or combat card that requires Dementation [dem], Dominate [dom], Obeah
[obe] or Serpentis [ser], this vampire can burn 1 blood to be immune to the
effects of that card.
[FOR] As above, and this vampire untaps at the end of this action.

> How does Resilient Mind interact with Lunatic Eruption? Does the
> card still go in play? Is blood only burned once for the whole time
> the card remains in play?

When lunatic erupion is played on the vampire with Resilient mind, he burns
one blood and the effect of the card do not apply to him. (RM card text) No
need to burn more blood.
however the minion taking the action to burn the card on him still takes one
damage.

> How does Resilient Mind vs. Vitae Block - does Vitae Block still go
> in play?

vitae block is played, RM vampire burns one blood, he does not move the 2/3
blood to the card, which is put into play anyway.

> How does Resilient Mind interact with Anesthetic Touch?

this one is difficult.
depending on what LSJ would say about anesthetic harming a vampire or not,
he may or may not be immune to the damage from anesthetic touch... (i'd say
he won't take the damage from the hand strike)
But since the "end combat" and "first strike" do not affect the RM vampire
directly, i'd say the still take place.
which mean : i play vitae block (sup), you burn one blood. the card is put
into play with no counters. i play anesthetic touch (sup), you burn one
blood, i hit you for zero 'cause you are immune, then combat ends before you
get a chance to hit back.

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
Reyda wrote:
> When lunatic erupion is played on the vampire with Resilient mind, he burns
> one blood and the effect of the card do not apply to him. (RM card text) No
> need to burn more blood.
> however the minion taking the action to burn the card on him still takes one
> damage.

Nit: Unless it's the Resilient Mind'ed vampire doing so.

> this one is difficult.
> depending on what LSJ would say about anesthetic harming a vampire or not,
> he may or may not be immune to the damage from anesthetic touch... (i'd say
> he won't take the damage from the hand strike)
> But since the "end combat" and "first strike" do not affect the RM vampire
> directly, i'd say the still take place.
> which mean : i play vitae block (sup), you burn one blood. the card is put
> into play with no counters. i play anesthetic touch (sup), you burn one
> blood, i hit you for zero 'cause you are immune, then combat ends before you
> get a chance to hit back.

That's correct. The "combat ends" is not an effect on the RM vampire.
Compare to dodging an Anesthetic Touch, for example (you dodge the
damage, combat still ends).

--Colin McGuigan
